meta.title: urlhub – link previews
meta.description: Paste links and see them as tiles or a table: picture, title and description of each page, YouTube duration, SEO warnings.

form.label: Enter URLs
form.hint: Separate with spaces, commas, or new lines · Ctrl + Enter fetches
form.advanced: Advanced: SEO warnings, keywords, Open Graph, canonical, robots, links and headings of each page

toolbar.filter: Filter by text, link or error
toolbar.shortLinkHint: Keeps the list on the server; unused for 90 days, it is deleted

notices.linkCopied: Link copied: it opens these results
notices.fetchAgain: Fetch again to get the advanced details.
notices.shortLinkCopied: Short link copied: {url} · The list is kept on the server; unused for 90 days, it is deleted.
notices.shortLinkFailed: The short link could not be made. Try again in a minute.

errors.empty: No links found. Links start with http:// or https://.
errors.tooMany: At most {max} links per request, got {count}.
errors.rateLimited: Too many links from your address. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.unreachable: The link service cannot be reached. Try again in a moment.
errors.service: The link service answered with an error ({status}).
errors.cutoff: The answer was cut off. Fetch again to complete the list.
errors.network: The connection was lost. Check it and fetch again.

recent.title: Recent queries
recent.remember: Remember recent queries on this device
recent.note: Kept only in this browser, never sent anywhere. Turning this off deletes them.
recent.empty: Nothing yet: your next queries will show up here.

details.hint: Fetch with the advanced option for SEO warnings, headings and more.

seo.noindex: Search engines are told not to index this page (noindex).

title-too-long.one: Title is {count} character (aim for at most {max}).
title-too-long.other: Title is {count} characters (aim for at most {max}).

title-too-short.one: Title is {count} character (aim for at least {min}).
title-too-short.other: Title is {count} characters (aim for at least {min}).

seo.description-missing: The page has no meta description.

description-too-long.one: Description is {count} character (aim for at most {max}).
description-too-long.other: Description is {count} characters (aim for at most {max}).

description-too-short.one: Description is {count} character (aim for at least {min}).
description-too-short.other: Description is {count} characters (aim for at least {min}).

seo.og-image-missing: No og:image: shared links show no picture.
seo.canonical-other: The canonical address is another one: {canonical}
seo.slow: The page took {seconds} s to load (over {limit} s).
seo.viewport-missing: No meta viewport: the page is not set up for phones.
seo.lang-missing: The <html> tag has no lang attribute.

status.title: Status
status.checked: Checked at {time} · refreshes every 30 s · counts only, no links
status.upFor: Up for {time} · Node {node} · counts start again at every restart
status.chartLabel: Links per hour; the same numbers are in the table below
status.quota: {used} of {daily} units today ({percent}) · the day starts again at midnight Pacific Time
status.quotaProblem: ⚠ {problem}: videos come from oEmbed for now
status.noKey: ⚠ No API key: videos come from oEmbed (no description or duration)
status.memoryLine: {pages} ({size} of 64 MB) for 30 min · {videos} for 1 h
status.noApi: ⚠ ldb-api does not answer, so there are no counts to show.

errorPage.shortLinkTitle: This short link does not exist
errorPage.shortLinkText: It may have expired: short links unused for 90 days are deleted. Ask whoever shared it for a new one.
